name: merge_benchs
description: merge_benchs is a merged collection of multiple benchmark tasks aggregated into a single evaluation suite. It is intended to measure model generalization across heterogeneous tasks (e.g., classification, QA, generation) by providing a unified testbed and aggregated metrics. The suite is useful for quick comparative evaluation of models across a diverse set of tasks.
reputation: A small, niche aggregated benchmark with limited community adoption compared to major standardized suites.
